Role Purpose:
This aluminium welder position involves using various techniques, like MIG and TIG welding, to join aluminium parts according to specifications and blueprints. They are responsible for preparing materials, inspecting welds, maintaining equipment, and ensuring safety and quality standards are met. This role often requires physical stamina, dexterity, and the ability to work in diverse environments. 

Key Responsibilities:
•	Knowledge and experience: Fabricating mild steel, stainless steel and aluminium components, products, and structures with MIG and TIG welding.
•	Material Preparation: Cutting, grinding, and preparing aluminium materials for welding. 
•	Equipment Operation and Maintenance: Operating and maintaining welding machines and equipment, including changing parts and ensuring proper functioning. 
•	Inspection and Quality Control: Inspecting welds for quality, adherence to safety regulations, and dimensional accuracy. 
•	Safety Compliance: Following all safety procedures and guidelines related to welding and material handling. 
•	Documentation: Maintaining records of work performed and materials used. 
•	Collaboration: Working with other welders, fabricators, and engineers to understand project requirements and ensure successful completion. 
•	Material Handling: Moving and storing finished products as needed. 

Essential skills needed:
•	Trade Certificate in Welding and/or 3+ years’ experience in welding.
•	Expertise knowledge of fabricating a variety of components, products, or structures (not just
production welding).
•	Thorough understanding of aluminium properties and welding characteristics.
•	Sound knowledge of Workplace Health and Safety requirements.
•	Physical Stamina - Ability to perform repetitive tasks and work in various positions
•	Physical Dexterity - Ability to handle tools and materials with precision
•	Supply & maintain own commercial grade tools, noting a tool maintenance allowance is included in the salary package.
•	Provide own vehicle to get themselves and their tools to site.
•	Maintain current driver’s license (manual preferred).

About You:
•	Ability to manage own time to meet agreed timeframe and projects.
•	Able to work on tasks autonomously or in a team.
•	Demonstrates a positive, willingness to learn and ability to follow directions from managers requirements.
•	Hard working and reliable.
•	Attention to detail and able to work to deadlines.

What you need to do now:
If you are interested and have the experience, we would love to hear from you!

Please click the 'APPLY' button now and send through your resume and cover letter detailing your previous relevant experience and why you are the perfect candidate for our team.

Please note, due to the high number of applications we expect to receive, we will only be responding to applicants who have been successful in securing an interview.

Additional Information:
Valid Qualification means:  Welder (First Class) - ANZSCO Skill Level 3: the occupation requires a high level of skill and expertise, typically associated with AQF Certificate III and at least two years of on-the-job training or an AQF Certificate IV. 

Tasks include:
•	Manufacturing items from start to finish, including measuring, marking out, cutting, deburring,
tacking together, welding, grinding, and finishing.
•	Knowledge in setting welding machines for different materials and weld joints.
•	Studying drawings and specifications to determine suitable material, method and sequence of
operations, and machine settings.
•	Fitting fabricated metal parts into products and assembling metal parts and subassemblies.
•	Checking fabricated and assembled metal parts for accuracy, clearance and fit using precision measuring instruments.
•	Interpreting work orders and determining the materials required. 
•	Problem-Solving: Identifying and addressing issues related to welding or material preparation
•	Maintain a high standard of workmanship and precision.
•	Log accurate records/documentation associated with your work as required and
•	Other duties as directed.

result.description:
Power Electronics / Power Systems Engineer
AC Electrical Systems
Motor Control & Starting Systems
Industrial Power Products
Embedded Control Electronics
VFD's, Switchgear, High Current
Long Term Permanent Position

We are looking for a Power Electronics engineer, ideally with practical experience working on AC electrical systems and motors, together with enough design capability to make a meaningful contribution to product development.

If you are in this space, we're keen to hear about:
Where you have worked and what you have worked on
What equipment or products you have worked on
What you have designed and significantly contributed to

The opportunity
Our state-of-the-art design and manufacturing facility in Port Kembla offers a multidisciplinary R&D, engineering and manufacturing environment developing and supporting globally deployed industrial electronic products associated with:
AC motors and motor control
power electronics
soft starters and motor-starting systems
VFDs and motor drives
industrial switching and control
protection, sensing and fault handling
embedded control hardware
current and voltage measurement
released-product improvement and production support
The role can suit a developing or established engineer, but it requires genuine practical experience rather than academic knowledge alone.

What you will work on...
Designing and developing power-electronics circuits and product subsystems.
Contributing to AC-side, mains-side and motor-control product development.
Working with power stages, switching devices, gate drivers, sensing and protection circuits.
Supporting soft starters, VFDs, motor controllers, contactors or related industrial switching products.
Selecting and applying SCRs, TRIACs, MOSFETs, IGBTs or similar switching devices.
Developing or reviewing schematics and PCB designs.
Considering high-current paths, thermal behaviour, EMC, isolation, creepage and clearance.
Building, testing and debugging prototype hardware.
Investigating failures found during development, production testing or field use.
Implementing corrective design changes and validating the results.
Working with embedded firmware, mechanical design, production and product lifecycle engineers.
Producing clear design records, test results and release documentation.
Essential experience
Your experience may be drawn from power electronics, motor control, industrial automation, switchgear, drives, machinery, renewable energy, industrial power conversion or electrical product manufacturing.

You must have:
Professional engineering experience involving AC systems and electric motors.
Substantive design or development capability.
The ability to explain what you personally designed, changed, calculated, selected, programmed, tested or validated.
Experience working with commercial products, electrical or electronic hardware.
An understanding of how designs progress from concept through prototype, test, correction and release.
A relevant qualification in electrical, electronic, power, mechatronics or a related engineering discipline.
Relevant technical experience

Experience in several of the following areas would be valuable:
Three-phase AC motors
induction motors or permanent-magnet motors
motor starting and current limiting
soft starters
variable-frequency drives
motor controllers
inverter power stages
AC-DC or DC-AC conversion
SCR or TRIAC control
MOSFET, IGBT or SiC switching
gate-driver circuits
current and voltage sensing
overcurrent, overvoltage and thermal protection
contactors and industrial switching
power-system or motor-protection interfaces
high-current PCB design
thermal design and component derating
EMC and switching-noise control
galvanic isolation
creepage and clearance
prototype bring-up and fault diagnosis
production and field validation
The design requirement
Applicants must have credible design capability.

This does not necessarily mean that you must have independently architected an entire commercial product. It does mean that you should have made real engineering decisions and be able to explain them.

Examples include:
selecting a circuit or system topology
designing or modifying a power stage
calculating component ratings
selecting switching devices
designing sensing or protection circuits
developing motor-control logic
preparing schematics
reviewing PCB current paths or layout
resolving thermal or EMC problems
changing a design after failed testing
validating a prototype or released-product modification

Candidates whose experience is limited to operating equipment, configuring relays, following test procedures, commissioning systems or reviewing imported designs will need to demonstrate additional personal design contribution / side projects.

Strong backgrounds may include...

We are particularly keen if you have worked for manufacturers, consultancies or engineering teams involved in:
motor drives and VFDs
soft starters
motor-control centres
industrial switchgear
pumps, compressors, fans or rotating equipment
industrial control products
power converters and inverters
UPS or renewable-energy systems
EV charging or electric-drive systems
mining, water, energy or heavy-industry equipment
electrical machinery and industrial automation

What we will ask you about
where you worked
what the company or project produced
what AC system, motor, drive or power product you worked on
the voltage, current and power level where available
what you personally designed
what you configured, integrated, tested or commissioned
which switching devices, controllers or protection systems were involved
whether the work reached prototype, factory test, field validation, production or commercial release
a technical problem you encountered and how you helped resolve it

Apply Now!
Please submit a resume that clearly identifies your relevant design exposure.

Employer questions
Your application will include the following questions:
Which of the following statements best describes your right to work in Australia?
Do you have experience in a sales role?

Key Responsibilities

Skills and Experience

•	At least two years of relevant marketing experience (or equivalent combination of qualifications and experience).
•	Strong understanding of digital marketing, social media, SEO/SEM, email marketing and content marketing.

Mechanical Engineering HVAC Maintenance and Install Technician

Work Type: Permanent – Full Time 

Location: Prop Up & Co Pty Ltd – Perth metro and regional WA areas

 Salary: $90,000 – $110,000 per annum 

Language: English

About Us

Prop Up & Co Pty Ltd is a Western Australian business specialising in facilities, project management, maintenance, compliance and admin support services for a range of ASX listed companies. 
We are committed to delivering high-quality service delivery solutions while maintaining the highest standards of safety, efficiency, and workmanship.

Due to ongoing business growth and increasing operational requirements, we are seeking a skilled and motivated Mechanical Engineering HVAC Technician to join our team on a full-time basis. This role will support the planning, implementation, maintenance, testing, and improvement of HVAC and mechanical systems and equipment across our operations.

About You

•	Proven experience in a Mechanical Engineering HVAC Technician or similar technical role.
•	Relevant qualification in Mechanical Engineering, Engineering Technology, or a related field.
•	Strong understanding of mechanical systems, equipment maintenance, and engineering principles.
•	Ability to interpret technical drawings, specifications, and engineering documentation.
•	Experience in troubleshooting mechanical faults and recommending practical solutions.
•	Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.
•	Ability to work independently and collaboratively within a team environment.
•	Excellent communication and organisational skills.
•	Commitment to workplace health and safety standards.
•	Australian work rights or eligibility to work in Australia.

The Role

As a Mechanical Engineering HVAC Technician, you will assist in the planning, quoting, installation, testing, maintenance, and optimisation of mechanical HVAC equipment and systems. You will work closely with management, engineers, and operational staff to ensure equipment reliability, operational efficiency, and compliance with relevant standards and regulations.

Tasks
•	Assisting in the design, installation, commissioning, and maintenance of mechanical HVAC equipment and systems.
•	Conducting inspections, testing, and diagnostic assessments of machinery and mechanical components.
•	Assisting engineers in developing and implementing maintenance schedules and procedures.
•	Monitoring equipment performance and identifying opportunities for operational improvements.
•	Investigating mechanical faults and equipment failures and recommending corrective actions.
•	Preparing technical reports, maintenance records, and operational documentation.
•	Interpreting engineering drawings, specifications, and technical manuals.
•	Assisting with the selection, procurement, and installation of mechanical components and equipment.
•	Ensuring machinery and equipment operate in accordance with engineering specifications and safety standards.
•	Supporting quality assurance processes through testing and performance evaluation of mechanical systems.
•	Coordinating with suppliers, contractors, and internal stakeholders regarding technical requirements and maintenance activities.
•	Assisting in inventory control and management of spare parts, tools, and equipment.
•	Ensuring compliance with workplace health and safety requirements and engineering standards.
•	Providing technical support and guidance to operational personnel regarding equipment usage and maintenance.
•	Performing other related duties as reasonably required by management in support of engineering and operational activities.

What We Offer
•	Competitive salary package of $90,000 – $110,000 per annum.
•	Long-term full-time employment opportunity.
•	Company vehicle and fuel card
•	Company phone
•	Supportive and professional working environment.
•	Opportunity to work on diverse engineering projects and develop technical skills.
•	Career growth and development opportunities within a growing business.

Work visa holders are welcome to apply for this position.
